# Repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

Read and follow `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `docs/PROJECT_LANGUAGE.md`, and any
applicable directory-specific instructions before making changes.

English is the sole canonical engineering and project language. Write repository
files, source comments, new commit messages, issue and PR titles/bodies, review
comments, and GitHub progress reports in English even when the task request is in
Japanese. Do not create Japanese document editions or bilingual summaries.

For existing non-English engineering records, translate complete requirements and
preserve decisions, explicit holds, references, checkbox states, and evidence
qualifications. Do not alter issue/PR lifecycle metadata or product behavior as a
translation side effect. Track legacy migration coverage and remaining work in
#965; never claim all records were migrated based on a partial batch.

Preserve intentional product localization, IME/Unicode fixtures, and exact
attributed evidence under the narrow exceptions in the policy. Explain exceptions
in English. Never publish private specification content, credentials, or
school-internal data, and never rewrite published Git history for language cleanup.
